name: dsh-cluster-ssh
description: LSF cluster execution channel for DeepSeek Harness over the system OpenSSH client: one authenticated interactive session, reused for fast subsequent commands, with sentinel-delimited output and ANSI/echo noise stripped.

plugin.note: Host-plane tool plugin. Requires the system 'ssh' client on PATH and a saved connection in $DSH_HOME/dsh-ssh-connections.json; the TOTP secret lives in $DSH_HOME/dsh-ssh-totp.json and is never committed.
